# VMBridge

> VMBridge is a macOS app for Parallels Desktop. It is an MCP server that gives an AI agent a virtual machine: screen, keyboard, mouse, commands, files, and snapshots. The intended price is $9.99 USD once, with a 7-day full-featured free trial. Parallels is a trademark of Parallels International GmbH. VMBridge is not affiliated with Parallels.

The command is `vmbridge`. `parallels-pro-mcp` and `guest-vm-agents` are aliases. Default site: https://vmbridgeapp.github.io. Alternative host: https://vmbridge.pages.dev. X: @vmbridgeapp. Source repository: https://github.com/AlexmChadwick/Parallels-Agents.

## Pages

- [MCP server for Parallels Desktop](https://vmbridgeapp.github.io/mcp-server-for-parallels-desktop/): VMBridge is an MCP server for Parallels Desktop. Agents see the VM screen, type, click, run commands, and move files without touching the Mac desktop.
- [Claude Code control a VM](https://vmbridgeapp.github.io/claude-code-control-a-vm/): Use Claude Code to control a Parallels Desktop VM with VMBridge. One command connects the agent. The VM's screen, keyboard, and mouse stay inside the guest.
- [AI agent virtual machine on Mac](https://vmbridgeapp.github.io/ai-agent-virtual-machine-mac/): Give an AI agent a virtual machine on a Mac. VMBridge runs on macOS and drives Parallels Desktop guests: Linux, Windows, and macOS, with per-VM permissions.
- [VMBridge vs VMPal](https://vmbridgeapp.github.io/vs-vmpal/): VMBridge and VMPal both give an AI agent a computer over MCP. VMPal is a hypervisor from TablePlus. VMBridge drives Parallels Desktop and is not affiliated with TablePlus.
- [VMBridge pricing](https://vmbridgeapp.github.io/pricing/): VMBridge is a $9.99 one-time purchase for macOS, with a 7-day full-featured free trial. It is not a subscription. A license key is checked with Lemon Squeezy.
- [VMBridge FAQ](https://vmbridgeapp.github.io/faq/): Answers about VMBridge for Parallels Desktop: the MCP server, the $9.99 license, the 7-day trial, Claude Code, the DMG, privacy, and how it differs from VMPal.
- [VMBridge docs](https://vmbridgeapp.github.io/docs/): Install VMBridge, connect an MCP agent, and read the trial rules. The same pages are plain Markdown for people and for answer engines.

## Quotable facts

VMBridge is the product name. The tagline is for Parallels Desktop. The product name does not include the word Parallels.

Hero: Let your AI agent drive Parallels Desktop VMs.

Price: $9.99 USD, one time. Trial: 7 days, full-featured, starting at first launch. Offline use after a successful license check: 14 days. A license key can be active on 2 machines and does not expire. License checks use the Lemon Squeezy License API and do not require a store API secret in the app. The default store id is 497255 (slug vmbridge), product id 1437706, variant id 2244841. Checkout: https://vmbridge.lemonsqueezy.com/checkout/buy/cbca7388-4a0c-4ccd-8e83-2e15f8e4f54f. The store is in test mode pending approval; that URL stays the same when the store is live. A key whose store id or product id does not match is rejected. The license text is a draft and is not legal advice.

Host requirements: macOS 14 or later, Parallels Desktop Pro or Business. The command is vmbridge. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other MCP clients.

VMBridge is not a hypervisor. It drives virtual machines that Parallels Desktop runs. It does not record VM video, does not expose a guest accessibility tree (it uses OCR), and cannot rename snapshots because prlctl has no rename.

VMPal is a VM application from TablePlus, first released 6 October 2026. Public notes as of 11 October 2026 refer to VMPal 0.69. VMBridge is an independent implementation. It contains no VMPal code and is not affiliated with TablePlus.

Parallels is a trademark of Parallels International GmbH. VMBridge is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Parallels International GmbH. VMPal is a product of TablePlus. VMBridge is not affiliated with TablePlus.

## Docs

# Quickstart

Give an agent a Parallels Desktop virtual machine. The host needs macOS 14 or later and Parallels Desktop Pro or Business.

## Install the command

```
git clone https://github.com/AlexmChadwick/Parallels-Agents.git
cd Parallels-Agents
./scripts/install.sh
```

That installs `vmbridge`. `parallels-pro-mcp` and `guest-vm-agents` are the same command. A notarized DMG ships with the GitHub release when a signed build is published. It is not a file on this website.

## Start the trial

Open VMBridge. The 7-day full-featured trial starts at first launch on that Mac. The price after the trial is $9.99 once. Buy opens the Lemon Squeezy checkout. The store is in test mode pending approval; the URL stays the same when the store is live.

## Connect Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor

```
vmbridge connect claude-code
vmbridge connect codex
vmbridge connect cursor
vmbridge connect list
```

Quit the agent and open it again so it loads the server. The same command covers Claude Desktop, Gemini CLI, VS Code, Windsurf, Cline, and the other MCP clients the app lists.

## Let it look at the guest

The agent can take a screenshot, read the text on the screen, click, and type. Those tools use the virtual machine's keyboard and mouse. They do not need Parallels Tools, which is how an agent can drive an installer. Commands, files, and the clipboard do need Parallels Tools.

## Stop it

Pause all agents from the menu-bar app, or turn off agent control for that VM. Either one is checked on the next tool call.

Source: https://vmbridgeapp.github.io/docs/quickstart/index.md

# Install VMBridge

VMBridge is a macOS app for Parallels Desktop. The host needs macOS 14 or later and Parallels Desktop Pro or Business, because the tools use prlctl and the Parallels Virtualization SDK.

## Developer install

```
git clone https://github.com/AlexmChadwick/Parallels-Agents.git
cd Parallels-Agents
./scripts/install.sh
```

That installs the `vmbridge` command. `parallels-pro-mcp` and `guest-vm-agents` are the same command.

## Connect an agent

```
vmbridge connect claude-code
vmbridge connect list
```

The same connect command covers Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Cline, Gemini CLI, and other MCP clients.

## Where state lives

The default folder is ~/Library/Application Support/VMBridge. Set VMBRIDGE_HOME to move it. PARALLELS_MCP_HOME still works. If the new folder does not exist and an older "Parallels Pro MCP" folder does, that older folder is kept so the trial clock is not reset.

Source: https://vmbridgeapp.github.io/docs/install/index.md

# Trial and license

VMBridge is a one-time purchase of $9.99 with a 7-day full-featured free trial. The trial starts at first launch on that Mac. It is stored in license.json and in the macOS login Keychain. Deleting only one of those copies does not restart the trial. Setting the clock back does not extend it.

## After you buy

A license key is activated with the Lemon Squeezy License API. No store API secret is shipped in the app. After a successful check, the app keeps working offline for 14 days.

## Store settings

These public identifiers are the defaults. Environment variables override them. They are not secrets.

- Store id 497255, slug vmbridge
- Product id 1437706
- Variant id 2244841
- Checkout https://vmbridge.lemonsqueezy.com/checkout/buy/cbca7388-4a0c-4ccd-8e83-2e15f8e4f54f
- A license key can be active on 2 machines. It does not expire.

VMBRIDGE_CHECKOUT_URL, VMBRIDGE_LEMON_STORE_ID, VMBRIDGE_LEMON_PRODUCT_ID, and VMBRIDGE_LEMON_VARIANT_ID override the defaults. GUEST_VM_AGENTS_CHECKOUT_URL, GUEST_VM_AGENTS_LEMON_STORE_ID, GUEST_VM_AGENTS_LEMON_PRODUCT_ID, and GUEST_VM_AGENTS_LEMON_VARIANT_ID still work.

A key whose Lemon Squeezy meta store_id or product_id does not match is rejected. Set an id to 0 or placeholder to skip that one check. The license text in the repository is a draft and needs legal review before the app is sold. The Lemon Squeezy store is in test mode pending approval. The checkout URL stays the same when the store is live.

Source: https://vmbridgeapp.github.io/docs/trial-and-license/index.md

# MCP tools for a Parallels Desktop VM

VMBridge speaks MCP. An agent on the Mac starts `vmbridge` over stdio. An agent inside a VM uses the daemon on the Parallels Shared or Host-Only network, with a token that works only for that VM.

## What an agent can do

- See the screen and read the text on it (vm_screenshot, vm_read_screen).
- Click, type, scroll, and drag with the VM's own keyboard and mouse.
- Run commands and move files (vm_run, vm_exec, vm_copy_to_guest, vm_copy_from_guest).
- List and focus windows, open an app or URL, and search files by name.
- Start, stop, pause, clone, and create VMs, and take and revert snapshots.
- Sign in at the login screen without the agent seeing the password.

## What it does not do

- It does not record video of the VM.
- It does not read the guest accessibility tree. On-screen text is OCR.
- It does not rename snapshots. prlctl has no rename.
- It is not a hypervisor. Parallels Desktop runs the VM.

Source: https://vmbridgeapp.github.io/docs/mcp-tools/index.md
